headline.zh: 民主党横扫国会，伊朗战争成败因
headline.en: Democrats sweep Congress as Iran war and data centers sink GOP

lede.zh: 美国中期选举中，民主党同时拿下参众两院，特朗普承认伊朗战争拖累了共和党，副总统万斯也开始与这场战争划清界限。选民还几乎在所有投票中否决了数据中心项目，给AI基建热潮泼了冷水；股市却大涨，道指涨约1500点。AI领域，OpenAI展示了自动发现并修补近千个Linux内核漏洞的系统，中国开源模型也再迎新品。
lede.en: Democrats took both chambers of Congress in a midterm rout that Trump himself partly blamed on the Iran war, while JD Vance began edging away from it. Voters also rejected data centers in nearly every ballot measure, a blow to the AI buildout, even as stocks rallied and the Dow gained 1,500 points. In AI, OpenAI showed an autonomous system that found and patched nearly a thousand Linux kernel bugs, and new open-weight models kept arriving.

title.zh: AI流水线揪出948个Linux提权漏洞
title.en: OpenAI pipeline finds and patches 948 Linux kernel bugs

hook.zh: 找漏洞、验证、写补丁，三步全交给机器，一口气做了948次。
hook.en: Find the bug, prove it, write the fix: a machine did all three, 948 times.

story.zh:
OpenAI周三公布，它搭建的一套全自动流水线在Linux内核里找到了948个“本地提权”漏洞，逐一验证，并生成了修补补丁。文章标题很直白：通往root的路，少了近一千条。

本地提权，好比一个只拿到访客卡的人，找到一扇没锁的门，径直走进了大楼总控室。攻击者先以普通用户身份登录，再借漏洞拿到最高权限root，整台机器就归他了。Linux内核跑在大量服务器和设备上，这类漏洞过去主要靠安全研究员手工去挖。

这次的不同在于“端到端”：发现、确认它真能被利用、写出补丁，整条链条都由系统完成。公开信息尚未说明这些补丁是否已被内核维护者合并。

同一天，OpenAI宣布Daybreak Red登陆AWS GovCloud美国东部区，通过Amazon Bedrock向获批客户提供GPT-5.6 Cyber模型，用于经授权的网络安全工作。
story.en:
On Wednesday OpenAI said an autonomous pipeline it built had found 948 local privilege-escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel, validated each one, and generated patches. The post's title sums it up: a thousand fewer paths to root.

A local privilege escalation is like a visitor with a lobby pass finding an unlocked door to the building's control room. An attacker logs in as an ordinary user, exploits the bug, and becomes root, the account that controls everything. The Linux kernel runs on a vast number of servers and devices, and hunting these flaws has largely been painstaking human work.

What's new is the end-to-end loop: discovery, confirmation that the bug is real, and a proposed fix, all handled by the system. OpenAI's announcement doesn't say whether kernel maintainers have accepted the patches yet.

The same day, OpenAI said Daybreak Red is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East), bringing GPT-5.6 Cyber through Amazon Bedrock to approved customers for authorized cybersecurity work.

why.zh: 几乎所有云服务和大量设备都依赖Linux，漏洞被成批修掉意味着更少的入侵口；但同样的能力也可以用来批量寻找攻击入口。
why.en: Most cloud services and countless devices depend on Linux, so fixing bugs in bulk closes doors for attackers — but the same capability can be pointed at finding doors to open.

pro.zh: 漏洞研究的瓶颈往往不在“发现”，而在“验证”：大量误报会淹没维护者，自动确认可利用性才让这个数字有意义。下一个瓶颈是人：近千个补丁需要内核维护者审阅，下游发行版和设备的更新也常常滞后数月。攻防能力是对称的，防守方能否占优，取决于修补速度能否跑赢发现速度。
pro.en: The hard part of vulnerability research is often triage, not discovery: false positives bury maintainers, so automated validation is what makes the 948 figure meaningful. The next bottleneck is human — nearly a thousand patches still need maintainer review, and downstream distributions and devices often lag by months. Discovery is dual-use; defenders only win if patch cycles outrun the pace of finding bugs.

label.zh: 被发现并生成补丁的内核提权漏洞
label.en: kernel privilege-escalation bugs found and patched

explain.zh: 已登录的普通用户利用漏洞获得管理员权限，像拿访客卡刷开了总控室的门。
explain.en: A logged-in ordinary user exploits a flaw to gain admin powers, like a visitor pass opening the control room.

explain.zh: Linux系统里权限最高的账户，能读写和控制一切。
explain.en: The all-powerful account on a Linux system that can read, change and control everything.

explain.zh: 操作系统的核心，负责调度硬件和程序，相当于大楼的配电和门禁系统。
explain.en: The core of an operating system that manages hardware and programs, like a building's wiring and access control.

title.zh: 腾讯Hy4、Kimi K3.1 Pro同日开放权重
title.en: Tencent Hy4, Kimi K3.1 Pro and Ripple-65B go open-weight

hook.zh: 一天之内，三款可以自己下载运行的模型登场，其中一款能替你点手机里的应用。
hook.en: Three downloadable models landed in a day, and one of them can tap through your apps for you.

story.zh:
周三，腾讯发布混元Hy4。它不仅能读文字，还能看懂图像，并且可以像人一样在应用里点按、操作。腾讯称它跻身中国最强模型之列，有报道强调其成本极低。这是腾讯继阿里之后走向开放权重。

同一天，Kimi K3.1 Pro的模型权重上传到Hugging Face，在Hacker News上拿到311分；美国实验室Ricursive则发布Ripple-65B预览版，声称是美国开放权重模型里“智能体编程”最强的。

开放权重，好比餐厅不仅卖菜，还把整份配方和半成品交给你，你可以在自家厨房照着做、改着做。“智能体编程”则是让模型自己读代码、改代码、跑测试，而不只是回答问题。

需要提醒的是，“中国最佳”“美国最强”都是公司自己的说法，尚待独立测试检验。
story.en:
On Wednesday Tencent released Hunyuan Hy4, a model that can see images as well as read text, and can click through apps the way a person would. Tencent says it ranks among China's best models; one report stressed its very low cost. The move follows Alibaba into open-weight AI.

The same day, weights for Kimi K3.1 Pro appeared on Hugging Face, drawing 311 points on Hacker News. And US lab Ricursive posted a preview of Ripple-65B, claiming the open-weight state of the art among US models on agentic coding.

Open weights are like a restaurant handing you the full recipe and prepped ingredients, not just the plated dish: you can cook it at home and tweak it. Agentic coding means the model reads code, edits it and runs tests on its own, rather than just answering questions.

A caveat: 'among China's best' and 'US state of the art' are the companies' own claims. Independent testing has yet to back them up.

why.zh: 开放权重让企业和开发者能在自己的服务器上免费部署强模型，压低AI使用成本，也让闭源厂商的定价空间更窄。
why.en: Open weights let companies run capable models on their own hardware, pushing down the cost of AI and squeezing pricing power for closed-model vendors.

pro.zh: 能“点应用”的模型属于图形界面智能体：把屏幕截图当输入，输出点击坐标或操作指令，难点在于多步任务中出错后的纠正。Ripple-65B的名字暗示约650亿参数，若其编程能力属实，说明中等规模模型也能在智能体任务上与更大模型竞争，部署门槛随之下降。美国实验室刻意强调“美国最强”，反映开放权重领域中美竞争已成为卖点。
pro.en: An app-clicking model is a GUI agent: it takes screenshots as input and outputs taps or actions, and the hard part is recovering from mistakes across multi-step tasks. Ripple-65B's name suggests roughly 65 billion parameters; if its coding claims hold up, mid-sized models can compete on agentic work, lowering deployment costs. A US lab framing its pitch as 'US state of the art' shows the US–China race has itself become a selling point in open weights.

label.en: Hacker News points for Kimi K3.1 Pro weights

explain.zh: 公开模型内部的全部参数，任何人都能下载运行和修改，像拿到了完整配方。
explain.en: Publishing a model's internal numbers so anyone can download, run and modify it, like getting the full recipe.

explain.zh: 模型自己动手读代码、改代码、运行测试，像一个会独立干活的实习程序员。
explain.en: A model that reads, edits and tests code on its own, like an intern programmer working unsupervised.

title.zh: Anthropic研发FlashProve，验证答案出自哪个模型
title.en: Anthropic's FlashProve would prove which model wrote an answer

hook.zh: 你付钱用的是顶级模型，但怎么确定对方没偷偷换成便宜货？
hook.en: You pay for a top model — but how do you know you weren't quietly served a cheaper one?

story.zh:
Anthropic周二发文，介绍一套名为FlashProve的开源系统：任何人都能用它核验，一段AI回答是否真的出自它声称的那个模型。

原理类似电子邮件的加密签名。AI实验室为每个发布的模型公开一个“指纹”，之后可以用密码学方法把具体输出和这个指纹对上。关键在于，指纹不会泄露模型权重，所以闭源厂商也能参与。验证过程足够轻，可以在本地设备上完成。

研究者举例：防止AI公司偷偷换上更便宜的模型省钱，或换上更贵的模型刷高成绩；也能核验“我的代码库经过前沿安全模型扫描”这类说法。另有报道称，这一工具可用来揭露暗中依赖Claude的中国模型，但Anthropic的原始说明并未这样表述。

目前代码和技术规范已在GitHub公开，但研究仍在进行，Anthropic和其他实验室都没有部署计划。
story.en:
Anthropic published a post on Tuesday describing FlashProve, an open-source system that would let anyone check whether an AI answer really came from the model it claims to be from.

Think of email signatures that prove a message came from its sender. Labs would publish a 'fingerprint' for each model, which can later be matched cryptographically to specific outputs. Crucially, the fingerprint doesn't reveal the model's weights, so closed-model makers could join in. Verification is light enough to run on a local device.

The researchers' examples: stopping a company from secretly swapping in a cheaper model to save money, or a pricier one to inflate results, and checking claims like 'my library was scanned by a frontier cybersecurity model.' One outlet reported the tool could expose Chinese models secretly relying on Claude, though Anthropic's own description doesn't frame it that way.

The spec and working code are on GitHub, but the research is unfinished and neither Anthropic nor any other lab plans to deploy it yet.

why.zh: 随着越来越多服务把“用了某某模型”当卖点，用户和企业需要一种不靠信任、靠数学的核验办法。
why.en: As more products advertise which model they run on, users and businesses need a way to check that claim with math rather than trust.

pro.zh: 这属于“可证明推理”：生成一份密码学证明，说明某输出确实由某组权重计算得出，而权重本身保密，思路接近零知识证明加承诺方案。最大挑战是开销，大模型推理本就昂贵，证明生成不能让成本成倍上涨，FlashProve强调轻量正是冲着这一点。它也能用于识别蒸馏或转售：若某服务声称自研，却与他人指纹吻合，就露了馅。
pro.en: This is 'provable inference': a cryptographic proof that an output was computed from a committed set of weights without revealing them — conceptually close to commitments plus zero-knowledge proofs. The main hurdle is overhead; inference is already costly, and proof generation can't multiply it, which is why FlashProve stresses being lightweight. It could also catch resellers or distillers: a service claiming its own model whose outputs match someone else's fingerprint would be exposed.

explain.zh: 用数学证明某个答案确实由特定模型算出，像给答案盖上无法伪造的公章。
explain.en: A mathematical proof that a specific model produced an answer, like an unforgeable seal on the output.

explain.zh: 决定模型行为的海量内部数字，是AI公司最核心的资产，像秘方。
explain.en: The vast set of internal numbers that define how a model behaves — an AI company's secret recipe.

title.zh: 美国中期选举：数据中心几乎全线落败
title.en: Voters reject data centers, and AI money fails at the ballot box

hook.zh: 从小镇公投到得州州长，数据中心成了选民投票时的“反面教材”。
hook.en: From small-town referendums to the Texas governor's race, data centers became something voters ran against.

story.zh:
周二美国中期选举，数据中心几乎在所有出现的地方都输了。据Redbud咨询统计，全国45项直接涉及数据中心的地方公投中，33项结果将限制建设；CNBC则称只有一项例外，各家统计口径不一。佛州Edgewater把禁令写进了城市宪章，堪萨斯El Dorado禁止峰值用电超10兆瓦的数据中心十年。

NBC出口民调显示，76%的选民反对在自家社区建数据中心。最大冲击在得州：民主党人希诺霍萨击败现任州长阿博特，她支持全州暂停建设；塔拉里科也击败帕克斯顿拿下参议院席位。得州是美国增长最快的数据中心市场，数百个项目悬而未决。

钱也没起作用。马斯克花了近5亿美元，创个人选举支出纪录；坐拥1亿美元的亲AI超级政治行动委员会“引领未来”收效甚微。周三盘前，AI数据中心股和SpaceX走低。

科技业则辩称，这是“反特朗普”而非“反科技”。
story.en:
In Tuesday's midterms, data centers lost almost everywhere they appeared on the ballot. Of 45 local measures, 33 will restrict development, per a tracker by Redbud Consulting; CNBC counted every measure but one going against them, so tallies differ. Edgewater, Florida, wrote a ban into its city charter; El Dorado, Kansas, barred facilities drawing over 10MW for a decade.

In NBC's exit poll, 76% of voters opposed data centers in their communities. The biggest blow landed in Texas, where Democrat Gina Hinojosa, who backs a statewide moratorium, unseated Gov. Greg Abbott, and James Talarico beat Ken Paxton for a Senate seat. Texas is the fastest-growing data center market in the US, with hundreds of projects now in doubt.

Money didn't help. Elon Musk spent nearly $500 million, an individual record, and the $100 million pro-AI super PAC network Leading the Future made little dent. AI data center stocks and SpaceX fell in Wednesday premarket trading.

Big Tech's response: the vote was anti-Trump, not anti-tech.

why.zh: 暂停令和取消税收优惠会拖慢AI算力扩张，银行已开始把地方反对当作信贷风险，融资成本可能随之上升。
why.en: Moratoriums and lost tax breaks could slow the AI buildout, and lenders already treat local opposition as a credit risk, which may raise financing costs.

pro.zh: 数据中心的瓶颈本就是电网接入和土地审批，地方政治恰好卡住这两处：阿博特此前启动的电网接入审计已可能放慢项目，新州长可借监管任命和环保执法进一步收紧。选民把数据中心与AI对就业、物价的影响捆绑在一起，单纯降噪节水难以平息。马斯克支出数字各家略有出入（BBC称近5亿，CNBC称4.74亿美元），但结论一致：巨额资金反而可能成了负担。
pro.en: Data centers are already bottlenecked by grid interconnection and permitting, and local politics squeezes exactly those points: Abbott's summer grid audit could already slow hookups, and new officials can tighten further through regulatory appointments and environmental enforcement. Voters link data centers to AI's effect on jobs and prices, so fixes for noise and water won't settle it. Musk's tally varies by outlet — nearly $500M per BBC, $474M per CNBC — but the takeaway is the same: the spending may have been a liability.

label.zh: 将限制数据中心建设的地方公投
label.en: local ballot measures that will restrict data centers

explain.zh: 在一段时间内冻结新项目审批，像按下暂停键而不是永久禁止。
explain.en: A temporary freeze on new approvals — a pause button rather than a permanent ban.

explain.zh: 可无限额募款、花钱投放政治广告的组织，但不能直接给候选人捐款。
explain.en: A group that can raise and spend unlimited money on political ads but can't donate directly to candidates.

explain.zh: 运营巨型数据中心网络的科技巨头，好比算力界的大型电厂。
explain.en: Tech giants running massive data center networks — the power plants of computing.

title.zh: OpenAI收购Pierre，为Codex补齐代码工具
title.en: OpenAI buys Pierre Computer to bolster Codex

hook.zh: OpenAI的编程助手不只想写代码，还想把代码存在自己家里。
hook.en: OpenAI's coding assistant wants not just to write your code, but to store it too.

story.zh:
OpenAI周三宣布，将收购开发者工具初创公司Pierre Computer，以扩充旗下编程产品Codex在构建、理解和审查代码方面的能力。交易金额未披露。

据《华尔街日报》报道，这笔收购会把Pierre的代码存储能力带进Codex；部分科技网站称共涉及三款工具，但OpenAI公告未逐一列明。

打个比方，Codex原本像一位会写代码的助手，而代码存放和审查是“仓库”和“质检”。把这两环收入囊中，开发者从写到存到审，都可以留在同一个平台里。

AI编程工具已是大模型公司争夺最激烈的场景之一。通过收购补齐工作流，是OpenAI加固Codex地位的直接办法。
story.en:
OpenAI said on Wednesday it will acquire developer-tooling startup Pierre Computer Company, expanding Codex's tools for building, understanding and reviewing code. Terms weren't disclosed.

The Wall Street Journal reported the deal brings Pierre's code storage into Codex. Some tech sites said three tools are involved, though OpenAI's announcement doesn't list them.

Think of Codex as an assistant that writes code; storage and review are the warehouse and the quality-control line. Owning those steps means a developer can write, store and check code without leaving one platform.

AI coding tools have become one of the most hotly contested arenas for model makers, and buying the missing pieces of the workflow is a direct way for OpenAI to shore up Codex.

why.zh: 开发者可能获得更一体化的编程工具，但也更容易被锁定在单一平台上。
why.en: Developers may get a more integrated toolchain, but also a stronger pull to stay locked into one platform.

pro.zh: 代码托管是开发流程的“记录系统”，谁掌握存储，谁就掌握上下文：AI代理能直接读取完整历史、分支和审查记录，生成和审查的质量都会受益。这也是平台锁定的经典路径，迁移代码库的成本远高于更换一个写代码的助手。审查工具同样关键，随着AI生成的代码量激增，审查正取代编写成为瓶颈。
pro.en: Code hosting is the system of record for software work: whoever holds the repository holds the context — full history, branches and review threads that make AI generation and review better. It's also a classic lock-in path, since moving a codebase costs far more than switching assistants. Review tooling matters too: as AI-written code piles up, reviewing it, not writing it, becomes the bottleneck.

explain.zh: OpenAI的AI编程产品，能帮开发者写代码、理解和审查代码。
explain.en: OpenAI's AI coding product that helps developers write, understand and review code.

explain.zh: 代码合并前由他人检查问题，像文章发表前的编辑校对。
explain.en: Having someone check code for problems before it's merged, like an editor proofreading before publication.

title.zh: 民主党横扫国会两院,特朗普遭重挫
title.en: Democrats sweep both chambers of Congress in rebuke to Trump

hook.zh: 民主党只需在众议院净增3席,结果预计拿下约255席,连堪萨斯这样的深红州都翻了盘。
hook.en: Democrats needed three more House seats; they are on track for about 255, and they won a Kansas Senate seat for the first time in 94 years.

story.zh:
周二夜里,美国选民给了特朗普当头一棒。NBC预测民主党将拿下约255个众议院席位,远超过半数所需的218席,可能是近二十年来最大的多数。参议院也随之易手。

参议院的战果更出人意料。牧师亚当·汉密尔顿击败堪萨斯州参议员马歇尔,成为该州94年来首位民主党参议员。缅因州的特洛伊·杰克逊击败老牌参议员柯林斯。密歇根的阿卜杜勒·赛义德将成为美国首位穆斯林参议员。密西西比州仍在计票,民主党人只领先几十票。

众议院翻盘的选区大多是特朗普2024年赢下的地盘。宾夕法尼亚州四名共和党现任议员落马,负责保住众院多数的共和党竞选委员会主席哈德森也输了。选民不满的是强硬移民政策、八个月的伊朗战争,以及推高油价和菜价的关税。佛州州长德桑蒂斯称这“近乎共和党的灭绝级事件”,众议院议长约翰逊宣布不再竞选少数党领袖。

1月3日新国会开幕,杰弗里斯预计成为首位黑人众议院议长。特朗普表示愿意接受结果。但这是他第二任期内第一次失去对国会的完全控制。
story.en:
On Tuesday night American voters handed Donald Trump the sharpest rebuke of his second term. NBC News projects Democrats will win about 255 House seats, far above the 218 needed and possibly their biggest majority in nearly two decades. They needed a net gain of just three. The Senate flipped too.

The Senate results were the biggest surprise. Pastor Adam Hamilton beat Sen. Roger Marshall to become Kansas's first Democratic senator in 94 years. Troy Jackson ousted Maine's Susan Collins. In Michigan, Abdul El-Sayed will become the first Muslim senator. In Mississippi, a Democrat leads by dozens of votes and the race is heading for an extended count.

Most House flips came in districts Trump carried in 2024. Four Pennsylvania Republicans lost, and so did Richard Hudson, the man in charge of protecting the GOP majority. Voters were reacting to an immigration crackdown, the eight-month Iran war and tariffs that pushed up the price of gas and groceries. Florida's Ron DeSantis called it “close to an extinction-level event” for his party. Speaker Mike Johnson says he won't seek to lead House Republicans in the minority.

On Jan. 3 Hakeem Jeffries is expected to become the first Black speaker of the House. Trump says he will accept the results. But for the first time this term, he no longer controls Congress.

why.zh: 从明年1月起,特朗普推法案、定预算都得和民主党讨价还价。他的政府还将面对国会主导的调查。
why.en: From January, Trump must bargain with Democrats over every bill and budget, and his administration will face investigations run by Congress.

pro.zh: 分治政府会让监督机器换手:委员会主席和调查工具归民主党,美联社称特朗普正面临民主党调查的阴影,《今日美国》称国防部长赫格塞斯可能面临弹劾投票。据CNBC,民主党在艾奥瓦、堪萨斯、北卡、俄亥俄、南卡、缅因和得州翻转了参议院席位。州级公投也对白宫不利:选民支持堕胎权,并否决了特朗普推动的选区重划。
pro.en: Divided government hands the oversight machinery to the other side. Committee gavels and investigative tools go to Democrats, AP says Trump now faces the specter of Democratic probes, and USA Today reports Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth may face an impeachment vote. CNBC lists Senate flips in Iowa, Kansas, North Carolina, Ohio, South Carolina, Maine and Texas. State ballot measures also went against the White House: voters backed abortion rights and rejected Trump's redistricting push.

label.zh: 民主党预计赢得的众议院席位

explain.zh: 总统任期过半时举行的国会选举,常被看作对总统的“期中考试”。
explain.en: The congressional election held halfway through a president's term, often treated as a mid-term report card on the president.

explain.zh: 白宫和国会由不同政党掌控,就像一家公司的CEO和董事会分属两派,大事都得谈。
explain.en: When the White House and Congress are run by different parties, like a CEO who must win over a hostile board for every big decision.

title.zh: 特朗普与万斯把败选归咎伊朗战争
title.en: Trump and Vance blame the Iran war; Tehran claims vindication

hook.zh: 特朗普承认伊朗战争拖累了选情,却说“还会再打一次”。他的副手则开始与这场战争划清界限。
hook.en: Trump admits the Iran war hurt his party and says he'd do it again. His vice-president is already edging away.

story.zh:
选后第二天,特朗普承认伊朗战争伤害了共和党,还抱怨没能把选民“对他的爱”转移给其他候选人。但他坚称自己“还会再做一次”。

副总统万斯走得更远。他引用一家他信任的民调机构称,从特朗普阵营倒向民主党的选民,最在意的就是伊朗战争和美以关系。多家媒体视之为他与特朗普的公开切割。他的帖子发出后,油价应声大跌。欧洲极右翼政党也开始与特朗普拉开距离。

德黑兰则在庆祝。伊朗首席谈判代表、议长加利巴夫说:“无论出于良知还是生活成本,美国人都对战争说了不,我们认同这一信息。”德黑兰革命广场近日还挂出写着“我们要杀死特朗普”的巨幅广告牌。

海湾国家并不轻松。它们正密集斡旋,担心战火重燃,而且打得更凶。信号也互相矛盾:彭博称特朗普在淡化空袭的可能,《卫报》则认为“把事情做完”的呼声可能推他恢复轰炸。伊朗称已备好“最大威慑”方案,国内要求造核武的声音也在增多。
story.en:
A day after the rout, Trump conceded that the Iran war had hurt Republicans. He also complained that he could not “transfer the love” voters feel for him to other candidates. But he insisted he would “do it again.”

Vice-President JD Vance went further. He cited a pollster he trusts as saying the Iran war and ties with Israel were top of mind for Trump voters who swung to Democrats. Several outlets read it as a public break with the president. Oil prices plunged after his post. Europe's far-right parties are also putting distance between themselves and Trump.

Tehran is celebrating. Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, parliament speaker and chief negotiator, said: “Conscience or the cost of living, Americans said NO TO WAR, and we endorse this message.” This week a giant billboard over Tehran's Enqelab Square read “We will kill Trump.”

The Gulf states are nervous. They are mediating furiously, fearing that a renewed war would be worse than the last. The signals conflict. Bloomberg reports Trump playing down the prospect of strikes, while the Guardian argues pressure to “finish the job” could tempt him to resume bombing. Iran says it has a “maximum deterrence” plan ready, and more voices there are calling for a nuclear weapon.

why.zh: 战争会不会重启,直接决定油价走向和海湾地区的安全。副总统公开与总统切割,也预示共和党内部的路线之争已经开始。
why.en: Whether the war restarts will drive oil prices and Gulf security. A vice-president openly breaking with his president on war also signals that the fight over the Republican Party's future has begun.

pro.zh: 万斯被视为总统热门人选,此举可看作为后特朗普时代提前卡位。市场把他的表态当作冲突升级风险下降的信号,当天WTI原油跌8.29%。更值得警惕的是伊朗国内的反应:一些神职人员和官员主张放弃不造核弹的长期承诺来重建威慑。若这一主张成真,外交空间会进一步收窄。
pro.en: Vance is seen as a presidential hopeful, and the move looks like early positioning for a post-Trump party. Markets read his post as lower escalation risk: WTI crude fell 8.29% on the day. The bigger worry is inside Iran, where some clerics and officials argue for dropping the country's longstanding pledge not to build a bomb in order to restore deterrence. If that view wins, the room for diplomacy shrinks.

explain.zh: 让对手觉得动手代价太大而不敢动手,就像门口拴着一条大狼狗。
explain.en: Making an attack look too costly to try, like a big dog chained at the gate.

title.zh: 蓝色浪潮下美股大涨,道指涨1500点
title.en: Wall Street cheers divided government as Dow jumps 1,500 points

hook.zh: 隔夜期货还在大跌,开盘后道指却录得年内最大涨幅,只有数据中心概念股成了输家。
hook.en: Futures sank overnight, then the Dow had its best day of the year. The exception was anyone betting on data centers.

story.zh:
周三,美股走出了出人意料的行情。选举夜股指期货大跌,因为投资者担心监管收紧。开盘后道指却一路涨约1500点,创年内最大单日涨幅。亚马逊涨8%,苹果涨近7%,谷歌涨逾6%。

摩根大通资管的David Kelly解释,分治政府意味着“增长温和、通胀温和、不确定性减少”。10年期美债收益率跌逾6个基点至4.884%。万斯把败选归咎伊朗战争后,油价跌逾8%。金价涨3.4%至每盎司4061美元,美元指数跌约0.3%,英镑升至脱欧公投以来最高。

输家同样明显。41项与AI数据中心有关的地方公投里,选民在40项中站在反对一方。主张暂停新建数据中心的民主党人赢下了得州、佐治亚和俄亥俄的州长选举。CoreWeave跌10%,特斯拉、SpaceX和英伟达走低,特朗普媒体科技集团股价也下滑。

下一个风险是债务上限。CNBC分析称,民主党可能借此逼特朗普在支出上让步,市场会很不喜欢这种对峙。摩根大通交易员也预计可能出现政府停摆。
story.en:
Wednesday's market did the opposite of what many expected. Stock futures fell sharply on election night as investors feared tougher regulation. Then the Dow climbed about 1,500 points, its biggest gain of the year. Amazon rose 8%, Apple nearly 7% and Google more than 6%.

JPMorgan Asset Management's David Kelly said divided government means “moderation in growth, moderation in inflation, less uncertainty.” The 10-year Treasury yield fell more than 6 basis points to 4.884%. Oil dropped more than 8% after JD Vance blamed the Iran war for the defeat. Gold rose 3.4% to $4,061 an ounce, the dollar index slipped about 0.3%, and the pound hit its highest level since the Brexit referendum.

The losers were easy to spot. Of 41 local ballot measures on AI data centers, voters sided against the projects in 40. Democrats who proposed data center moratoriums won governor's races in Texas, Georgia and Ohio. CoreWeave fell 10%, Tesla, SpaceX and Nvidia slipped, and Trump Media shares slid.

The next risk is the debt ceiling. A CNBC analysis says Democrats may use it to extract spending concessions from Trump, a standoff markets will hate. JPMorgan traders say the path to lower deficits could run through a government shutdown.

why.zh: 更低的利率和油价能减轻贷款和加油的负担。但地方对数据中心的抵制,可能拖慢AI基建,并把优势推向现金充裕的科技巨头。
why.en: Lower yields and cheaper oil ease borrowing and fuel costs. But local resistance to data centers could slow the AI build-out and hand the advantage to cash-rich tech giants.

pro.zh: Needham分析师Laura Martin认为,监管门槛提高会巩固在位者,并抬高新进入者的必要回报率。所以有现金流和建设经验的超大规模云厂商上涨,新兴AI云服务商则受挫。麦格理指出,备用电源排放、用地、用水、并网和税收多由州监管机构掌管,因此州长人选直接关系项目进度。债市方面,财政刺激减少压低长端利率,但短期国债可能因债务上限计入额外风险溢价。
pro.en: Needham's Laura Martin argues that higher regulatory barriers entrench incumbents and raise the returns new entrants need. That is why hyperscalers with cash flow and building experience rallied while neoclouds sank. Macquarie notes that backup-power emissions, zoning, water, grid connection and taxes are often overseen by state regulators, so governors directly affect project timelines. In bonds, less fiscal stimulus argues for lower long yields, but StoneX flags a debt-limit premium building in short-term bills.

explain.zh: 亚马逊、微软、谷歌这类最大的云服务商,像拥有自家电厂和地皮的超级房东。
explain.en: The biggest cloud providers, like Amazon, Microsoft and Google, which are something like landlords who own their own land and power plants.

explain.zh: 0.01个百分点,用来描述利率的细微变化。
explain.en: One hundredth of a percentage point, the unit used for small moves in interest rates.

explain.zh: 国会给联邦政府借钱设的总额度,像信用卡额度,用满了就必须国会批准提额。
explain.en: A legal cap on federal borrowing, like a credit card limit that only Congress can raise.

title.zh: 俄军轰炸乌克兰援助点,至少40人遇难
title.en: Russian strike on Ukrainian aid hub kills at least 40

hook.zh: 一名警察的执法记录仪拍下村民涌入防空洞的画面,随后画面一片漆黑。
hook.en: A police bodycam shows villagers hurrying into a shelter. Then the screen goes black.

story.zh:
周一,扎波罗热州前线村庄科梅舒瓦哈,村民聚集在一所学校领取人道援助。乌方称,俄军投下九枚滑翔炸弹,部分重达3000公斤。炸弹先落在领物资的人群中,再落向赶来的救援人员和警察。

乌克兰警方周三公布了一名遇难警察的执法记录仪视频。第一轮轰炸后,对讲机里传来更多炸弹来袭的警告。警察喊着“快进防空洞!”,居民走进至少两层深的地下掩体。随后传来爆炸声和火光,画面中断。BBC已核实拍摄地点。

泽连斯基说,死亡人数已升至40人,另有30多人可能仍埋在废墟下。遇难者中有4名警察和2名救援人员。俄军无人机仍在干扰搜救。联合国驻乌人权监察团称,这次轰炸很可能违反国际法。

袭击发生在美国斡旋的和谈前夕,乌俄代表将于11月10日至11日在阿布扎比会面。泽连斯基抱怨“世界反应太少”。分析人士不看好会谈取得突破。克里姆林宫则表示,希望美国中期选举不影响特朗普的“和平努力”。
story.en:
On Monday, villagers in Komyshuvakha, a front-line village in Zaporizhzhia, gathered at a school to collect humanitarian aid. Ukraine says Russia dropped nine glide bombs, some weighing 3,000kg. They hit first the crowd, then the rescuers and police who rushed in.

On Wednesday Ukrainian police released bodycam footage from one of the four officers killed. After the first strike, a radio voice warns of more glide bombs on the way. “Quickly to the shelter!” an officer shouts, and residents file into a bunker at least two floors underground. A blast and flames follow, then the footage cuts to black. BBC Verify confirmed the location.

President Zelensky says 40 people are confirmed dead and more than 30 may still be under the rubble. Four police officers and two rescuers are among the dead. Russian drones are hampering the search, and the UN human rights mission says the bombing likely violated international law.

The strike came days before US-brokered talks, with Ukrainian and Russian delegations due in Abu Dhabi on November 10-11. Zelensky lamented “very little reaction from the world.” Analysts expect no breakthrough. The Kremlin says it hopes the US midterms won't derail Trump's “peacemaking efforts.”

why.zh: 这是近五年战争中针对平民最致命的袭击之一。它也让下周和谈的气氛更加紧张。
why.en: It is one of the deadliest attacks on civilians in a war now nearly five years old, and it darkens the mood ahead of next week's talks.

pro.zh: “双重打击”专门针对第一轮爆炸后赶来救人的人员,因此常被人权机构视为可能的战争罪证据。滑翔炸弹从敌方防空射程外投放,便宜且难拦截。BBC指出,自二月三方会谈中断后,莫斯科加强了空袭,而基辅几乎用光了西方提供的拦截弹。俄方在谈判中仍坚持要求乌克兰割让领土、非军事化并放弃加入北约,这让阿布扎比会谈很难有实质进展。
pro.en: A double-tap strike targets the people who rush in after the first blast, which is why rights monitors treat the pattern as potential evidence of war crimes. Glide bombs are released from outside air-defence range and are cheap and hard to stop. The BBC notes that since trilateral talks stalled in February, Moscow has intensified attacks while Kyiv has nearly run out of Western-supplied interceptors. Moscow still demands territory, demilitarisation and a pledge never to join NATO, which leaves Abu Dhabi little room to deliver.

explain.zh: 先打一次,等救援人员赶到再打第二次,就像在火灾现场等消防员到了再放一把火。
explain.en: Hitting a site once, then again when rescuers arrive, like setting a second fire just as firefighters show up.

explain.zh: 从飞机上投下、靠翼面滑行很远才落地的炸弹,飞机不必靠近目标。
explain.en: A bomb dropped from a plane that glides a long way to its target, so the aircraft can stay far away.

title.zh: 黑客调高法国血库冷库温度
title.en: Hackers turn up the heat in French blood bank cold stores

hook.zh: 这波专挑冰箱下手的网络攻击,已经从欧洲超市蔓延到储存血液的冷库。
hook.en: A wave of cyberattacks on fridges has spread from Europe's supermarkets to the rooms where France keeps its blood.

story.zh:
法国血液机构EFS周三披露,周一夜间,黑客侵入了三处冷库的控制系统,把温度和除霜阈值调到“非常高的水平”。这些冷库由EFS的承包商运营,存放着血液制品。好在报警系统及时响起,技术人员在制品受损前介入。

EFS是法国的公立输血机构,向1900多家医院供应血液、血浆和血小板,每年服务上百万名患者。

这并非孤立事件。本周,近十几个欧洲国家的超市冰柜温度飙升到50°C,造成数百万欧元的食品损失。上个月,法国多达700家超市的制冷设备被黑客控制。8月,美国至少六个军事基地的商店也出现神秘的冰箱故障,五角大楼正在调查是否遭到入侵。

至今无人认领,动机不明。欧盟发言人称各机构正紧急协调共同应对。网络安全公司Sophos的专家认为,最可能的是国家行为者在“展示能力”,或者是单独行动的黑客。西方情报官员此前指称,俄罗斯正在欧洲开展多种形式的破坏活动。
story.en:
France's blood service, EFS, said on Wednesday that hackers had broken into the control systems of three cold stores overnight on Monday. They raised temperature and defrosting thresholds to “very high levels.” The stores, run by EFS contractors, hold blood products. Alarms went off in time, and technicians stepped in before anything was compromised.

EFS is France's public transfusion operator. It supplies blood, plasma and platelets to more than 1,900 hospitals and supports over a million patients a year.

The attack is part of a pattern. This week supermarket fridges and freezers in almost a dozen European countries hit temperatures as high as 50C, ruining millions of euros of food. Last month hackers seized cooling units in as many as 700 French supermarkets. In August, mysterious fridge failures hit commissaries on at least six US military bases, and the Pentagon is investigating a suspected hack.

No one has claimed responsibility and no motive is known. An EU spokesperson said the bloc's agencies are urgently coordinating a joint response. Sophos threat expert Rafe Pilling says the most plausible culprits are a state showing off its capabilities or a lone-wolf hacker. Western intelligence officials already accuse Moscow of a wide-ranging sabotage campaign in Europe.

why.zh: 攻击对象从超市冰柜升级到医疗物资,风险已经从财产损失变成可能危及病人。
why.en: Moving from grocery freezers to blood supplies raises the stakes from spoiled food to patients' lives.

pro.zh: 商用制冷系统越来越多地联网,可以远程监控和调节。如果软件漏洞没有及时打补丁,黑客就能从网上直接改设定值。这次被攻破的是承包商的冷库,说明供应链往往是最薄弱的一环。最终挡住损失的是独立报警系统,这也提醒运营方:监测设备要和控制设备分开设计。
pro.en: Commercial refrigeration is increasingly internet-connected and remotely controlled. Unpatched software lets attackers change set-points from anywhere. Here the breach came through contractors' facilities, a reminder that the supply chain is often the weakest link. What saved the stock was an independent alarm layer, which argues for keeping monitoring separate from the systems it watches.

label.zh: 被黑超市冰柜的最高温度
label.en: Peak temperature in hacked supermarket fridges

explain.zh: 远程调节设备运行的软件,相当于冷库的“遥控器”,落到坏人手里就能随意调温。
explain.en: Software that runs equipment remotely; think of it as the cold store's remote control, which is dangerous in the wrong hands.

explain.zh: 修补软件漏洞的更新,好比给破了洞的篱笆补上木板。
explain.en: A software update that fixes a security hole, like nailing a board over a gap in a fence.

title.zh: 以色列总统启动组阁磋商
title.en: Israel's president opens coalition talks after deadlocked vote

hook.zh: 内塔尼亚胡阵营53席,对手48席,而能左右结局的19席,握在几乎没人愿意合作的阿拉伯政党手里。
hook.en: Netanyahu's bloc has 53 seats, his rivals 48, and the 19 that could decide it belong to parties almost nobody will partner with.

story.zh:
周三上午,以色列中央选举委员会主席索尔伯格把10月27日大选的正式结果交给总统赫尔佐格。当晚,赫尔佐格开始与各党磋商,用两天时间决定让内塔尼亚胡还是对手艾森科特先试组阁。

这次选举没有赢家。在120席的议会中,利库德集团与极右翼、极端正统派盟友共拿下53席。艾森科特的中间派Yashar党与另外三个反对党共48席。阿拉伯选民投票率激增,两个阿拉伯政党联盟拿下创纪录的19席,成了潜在的“造王者”。但选前除一个政党外,犹太政党都承诺不与它们合作。据《以色列时报》,拉姆党将推荐艾森科特,这可能让他拿到第一个组阁机会。

选后火药味很浓。内塔尼亚胡阵营指阿拉伯政党“偷走”选举,选委会称找不到违规证据。艾森科特斥之为“针对民主的迫害”。赫尔佐格谴责针对阿拉伯公民的种族主义言论,并警告各党:想避免重新选举,就“不可能兑现所有承诺”。

获提名者有28天组阁,可再延长14天。
story.en:
On Wednesday morning, election chief Noam Sohlberg handed President Isaac Herzog the official results of the October 27 vote. That evening Herzog began two days of meetings with party leaders to decide whether Benjamin Netanyahu or his rival Gadi Eisenkot gets the first try at forming a government.

Nobody won outright. In the 120-seat Knesset, Netanyahu's Likud and its far-right and ultra-Orthodox allies took 53 seats. Eisenkot's centrist Yashar and three other opposition parties took 48. After a surge in Arab turnout, two Arab-led alliances won an unprecedented 19 seats, making them potential kingmakers. Yet all but one Jewish party pledged before the vote not to govern with them. The Times of Israel reports that Ra'am will recommend Eisenkot, which would likely give him the first shot.

The mood is bitter. Netanyahu's camp claims Arab-led parties “stole” the election, and the election committee found no evidence of irregularities. Eisenkot called it a “pogrom against democracy.” Herzog condemned racist remarks against Arab citizens and told parties that “not every commitment and promise can be fulfilled” if they want to avoid another election.

Whoever is chosen gets 28 days to build a coalition, with a possible 14-day extension.

why.zh: 谁来组阁将决定以色列的战争走向和对外关系。如果组阁失败,以色列将再次举行大选。
why.en: Whoever forms the government will steer Israel's wars and foreign ties, and failure means yet another election.

pro.zh: 总统可以自由裁量,不必选第一大党领袖,而是看谁最有可能凑够61席。两大阵营都离这个数差得远,只能靠阿拉伯政党或对方阵营倒戈。制度护栏也在起作用:总检察长阻止了辛贝特传讯阿拉伯政党政治人物的要求。外部环境同样变了,《纽约时报》指出,美国民主党大胜后,以色列在国会的朋友更少了。
pro.en: The president has wide discretion and need not pick the largest party's leader, only the person most likely to reach 61 seats. Neither bloc is close without Arab-led parties or defections from the other side. Institutional guardrails are holding: the attorney general blocked a Shin Bet bid to interrogate politicians from Palestinian-led parties. The outside picture has shifted too. The NYT notes that after the Democratic sweep, Israel has fewer friends in the US Congress.

label.zh: 阿拉伯政党联盟所获席位(共120席)

explain.zh: 没有政党单独过半时,几个党拼凑出过半数席位来组成政府,像几家人凑钱合买一套房。
explain.en: When no party wins a majority alone, several parties pool their seats to govern, like families chipping in to buy one house.

explain.zh: 自己当不了主角,却能决定谁当主角的一方。
explain.en: A player who can't win the crown but decides who wears it.
